newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude advances in late day U.S. paper trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude advances in late day U.S. paper trade.

text.p: North Sea Brent crude oil advanced a touch in late day U.S. paper trade amid talk one full boat was done at $18.95 a barrel or a cent above the earlier settlement price on the IPE in London, traders said.
The deal was closed by a Wall Street trading house, which sold the cargo to a European major.
A number of partial cargoes also changed hands, including 100 lots at $18.95 a barrel, 100 lots at $18.92 and another 100 lots at $18.90, traders said.
